# Condition-group risk tables, lesion map, parameter sets and case mix

**Status: awaiting a clinical check.** The first table is generated by `cardiac_capacity.risk_groups.table_markdown()`.

How to read it. The model's categories are urgency classes, not lesions. These group risks are **not** wired
into the category rates silently: the `PLACEHOLDERS` set keeps the v1 category rates (0.12 / 0.07 / 0.04 / 0.02
per week) and the `LITERATURE` set uses the sourced hazards of the lesion mapped to each category (sections 1 and 2 below).

Limits stated plainly:
- Untreated hazards are **upper bounds** (no treatment of any kind). The risk for a medically managed patient on a list is not
  published in the sources used here; a clinician sets it.
- Odds ratios for timing of repair or type of operation (ToF neonatal repair, HLHS hybrid vs Norwood) are about the operation, not
  the wait, and are not applied.
- TGA, HLHS and the VSD loss of operability are deadlines plus bridges; a weekly rate for them is a stress-test value only.
- The weekly risk after the long-wait rule applies a complication odds ratio to a death or escalation hazard: an assumption.

| Group | Untreated weekly hazard (upper bound) | Interval | Weekly risk after long-wait rule (odds x 1.49) | Rate source | Published OR/RR (and why used or not) | Use in model | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|

| Transposition (TGA, simple) | 4.33% | weeks 0-52 (about 90% dead at 1 y untreated) | n/a | Indian guideline 2019 (chd-indications-timing-intervention): mean untreated life 0.65 y | None for waiting. Switch within 3-4 weeks is a deadline | Deadline plus bridge (septostomy), not a rate: no long-wait multiplier applied | awaiting a clinical check |
| TGA with VSD | n/a | week 1 repair is the norm | n/a | No sourced weekly hazard (expert table: about 1 y untreated) | Repair after day 8: composite complications aOR 1.49; mortality 3.1% whatever the timing | Source of the generic long-wait odds multiplier (1.49) | awaiting a clinical check |
| Complete AVSD | 2.34% | weeks 0-26 (1.65% weeks 26-52) | 3.45% | Guideline: 54% alive at 6 mo, 35% at 12 mo; Weibull shape 0.77 | None for waiting (weight below 4 kg lengthens ventilation and stay) | Weekly upper bound; irreversible pulmonary vascular disease can start by 6 months (Down syndrome) | awaiting a clinical check |
| Large VSD (death) | 0.20% | weeks 0-52 | 0.30% | Guideline: about 10% die in year 1 (heart failure) | None for waiting | Weekly upper bound for death | awaiting a clinical check |

| Hypoplastic left heart (HLHS) | n/a | weeks 0-4 (50% in week 1 untreated) | n/a | About 95% die early untreated (hybrid vs Norwood meta-analysis, Gobergs et al. 2016, doi:10.6001/actamedica.v23i2.3325) | Hybrid vs Norwood interstage mortality RR 1.61 (1.10-2.33); home monitoring interstage 2.5% vs 10.3%: about the operation and the interstage, not the wait | Deadline plus bridge (prostaglandin): no weekly rate is derived | awaiting a clinical check |

## Lesion map, parameter sets and case mix

**Status: awaiting a clinical check.** Sources are the cited papers only; where none gives a figure the cell says
"awaiting source".

### 1. Lesion group to urgency category (proposal)

The ranking uses the sourced window or deadline and the sourced weekly hazard, not clinical judgement.

| Lesion group | Ward category | CICU category | Basis (window or deadline) | Source | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Transposition (TGA, simple) | 1 | 1 | Hard deadline: arterial switch within 3-4 weeks before the left ventricle regresses; about 90% dead at 1 y untreated | Saxena et al. 2019, doi:10.4103/apc.apc_32_19; Dorobantu et al. 2023, doi:10.1016/j.jacadv.2023.100407 (median age 9.5 d) | awaiting a clinical check |
| TGA with VSD | 1 | 1 | Repair mostly in week 1 (median 6 days); complications rise when repair is after day 8 | Faateh et al. 2025, doi:10.1016/j.xjon.2024.10.015 | awaiting a clinical check |
| Hypoplastic left heart (HLHS) | 1 | 1 | Fatal untreated, usually within the first week; stage 1 needs prostaglandin then a neonatal operation | Gobergs et al. 2016, doi:10.6001/actamedica.v23i2.3325; Iskander et al. 2024, doi:10.3390/jcm13144244 | awaiting a clinical check |
| Obstructed TAPVC (not one of the five groups) | 1 | 1 | Obstruction means no safe wait: emergency surgery in 18% of the series | Ji et al. 2021, doi:10.3389/fcvm.2021.775578 | awaiting a clinical check |
| Complete AVSD | 2 | 2 | Highest sourced weekly hazard among lesions that are not deadlines (2.34% weeks 0-26; 54% alive at 6 months); irreversible pulmonary vascular disease can start by 6 months in Down syndrome; median age at repair 191 days in one series | Saxena et al. 2019, doi:10.4103/apc.apc_32_19; Al-Wassia et al. 2022, doi:10.1186/s43044-022-00292-8 | awaiting a clinical check |
| Large VSD | 3 | 3 | Sourced risks are heart-failure death (about 10% in year 1, 0.20%/wk) and irreversible pulmonary vascular disease (52%, onset in infancy in four-fifths, 1.03%/wk); no repair window is given in the cited sources (awaiting source), so it sits below AVSD on hazard | Saxena et al. 2019, doi:10.4103/apc.apc_32_19 | awaiting a clinical check |
| Tetralogy of Fallot (ToF) | 4 | 4 | Elective window 3-6 months when asymptomatic or mildly symptomatic (immediately if severe, which moves the child up); too-early repair costs mortality | Martins et al. 2018, doi:10.21470/1678-9741-2018-0019; Rampengan et al. 2025, doi:10.4103/apc.apc_228_24 | awaiting a clinical check |
| Small or moderate VSD and other routine lesions | 5 | 4 | No sourced weekly risk; spontaneous closure in 60% of 132 children with isolated VSD followed to 6 years, so waiting is often benign | Li et al. 2019, doi:10.1002/clc.23173; Saxena et al. 2019, doi:10.4103/apc.apc_32_19 | awaiting a clinical check |

### 2. Weekly rate of moving up a category: two explicit parameter sets

`PLACEHOLDERS` is what v2 shipped; `LITERATURE` feeds the sourced untreated hazards of the lesion mapped to each category. Those
hazards are death or loss of operability with no treatment at all: upper bounds for death, and only proxies for "moves up a
category". The weekly risk of a medically managed child on a list is **awaiting source**.

| Transition | Placeholders (ward / CICU) | Literature-based | Basis for the literature value |
|---|---|---|---|
| Category 2 to 1 | 12.00% / 5.00% | 2.34% | Complete AVSD untreated hazard, weeks 0-26 (guideline: 54% alive at 6 mo) |
| Category 3 to 2 | 7.00% / 2.00% | 1.23% | Large VSD: death 0.20% and loss of operability 1.03% per week, combined as independent events |
| Category 4 to 3 | 4.00% / 1.00% | 0.80% | ToF untreated hazard, weeks 0-52 (66% survive 1 y) |
| Category 5 to 4 | 2.00% /  | 2.00% | Awaiting source: v1 placeholder kept |
| Long-wait odds multiplier (after 26 weeks) | 1.49 | 1.0 | No source supports a generic factor |

Long-wait multiplier: the only published figure found is the TGA+VSD post-operative composite-complication odds ratio
for repair after day 8 of life (aOR 1.49, 95% CI 1.02-2.15; the paper's body gives 1.47). Wrong outcome (after surgery, not while
waiting), wrong time scale (days of life, not 26 weeks), one lesion, observational and confounded by prematurity, so it is **not
supported as a generic factor**. The literature set uses 1.0. The lesion-specific use survives in the case-mix model: a TGA+VSD
repair after day 8 adds about 6.6 points of composite complications (24.0% versus 17.4%).

Not modelled: a cath-lab queue and bridge procedures, weight- and age-dependent stay, a patient age clock.
